name: stream-after-grant-revocation
invariant: An event stream is re-authorized on every change and before every frame, with checks never more than the poll bound apart and every write bounded by the next check: once the reader's grant is revoked or expires, even after idling over HTTP/2, mid-delivery, across a slow write or behind a stalled client, the stream closes with failed/authority_revoked before any later frame, and it cannot be reopened (04 "Read authorization"; 08 "Reads, commands, events").
